name: Upload File
description: Upload a file to OneDrive. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/api/driveitem_put_content?view=odsp-graph-online)

configurable_props.name: driveId
configurable_props.label: Drive ID
configurable_props.description: Identifier of a drive within a site

configurable_props.name: uploadFolderId
configurable_props.label: Upload Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the folder where you want to upload the file. You can either search for the folder here or provide a custom *Folder ID*.

configurable_props.name: filePath
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: The file to upload. Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the `/tmp` directory (for example, `/tmp/myFile.txt`)

configurable_props.name: filename
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the new uploaded file
